title: Literature Review of Mixed Reality Research
abstract: arXiv:2312.02995v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In the global context, while mixed reality has been an emerging concept for years, recent technological and scientific advancements have now made it poised to revolutionize industries and daily life by offering enhanced functionalities and improved services. Besides reviewing the highly cited papers in the last 20 years among over a thousand research papers on mixed reality, this systematic review provides the state-of-the-art applications and utilities of the mixed reality by primarily scrutinizing the associated papers in 2022 and 2023. Focusing on the potentials that this technology have in providing digitally supported simulations and other utilities in the era of large language models, highlighting the potential and limitations of the innovative solutions and also bringing focus to emerging research directions, such as telemedicine, remote control and optimization of direct volume rendering. translated_title: 混合现实研究的文献综述
translated_abstract: 在全球背景下，混合现实多年来一直是一个新兴概念，而近期技术与科学的进步使其有望通过提供增强的功能和改进的服务，彻底改变各行各业和日常生活。本文系统综述了过去20年间一千多篇混合现实研究论文中的高被引论文，并重点审阅2022年和2023年的相关论文，展示了混合现实最前沿的应用与效用。本文聚焦于该技术在大语言模型时代提供数字化支持模拟及其他效用的潜力，强调了创新解决方案的优势与局限性，并关注了新兴研究方向，如远程医疗、远程控制以及直接体积渲染的优化。
tldr: 本文系统综述了近20年混合现实领域的高被引论文及2022-2023年的最新研究，重点分析了该技术在大语言模型时代提供数字化支持的模拟与应用方面的潜力、局限性及新兴研究方向。
en_tdlr: This systematic review surveys highly cited mixed reality papers from the past two decades alongside recent 2022-2023 literature, highlighting the technology's potential, limitations, and emerging research directions in the era of large language models.
